{"stops":[{"poi_id":"p1","kind":"activity","must_do_id":"m1","note":"Stand where the Tagus meets the Atlantic and let the old stone tell you about sailors and cannons."},{"poi_id":"p2","kind":"activity","must_do_id":"m2","note":"Manueline stonework so rich it looks like the sea carved it between voyages."},{"poi_id":"p16","kind":"meal","must_do_id":null,"note":"Vegan comfort food that even a sardine like me respects, hearty and full of flavour."},{"poi_id":"p5","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"Warehouse walls turned into street art, little shops and the smell of fresh coffee."},{"poi_id":"p16","kind":"meal","must_do_id":null,"note":"Back for round two, because good vegan food near the river is worth the return."}]}
Alfama, Belém, castle views — every must-do in, so come for the grilled sardines. Stay for the grilled sardines.
